estimationLogic.baseCost: Calculated by Area (sqft) multiplied by base service rates.
estimationLogic.materialPremium: Material selection multiplier (Laminate baseline, Acrylic/Teak premium).
estimationLogic.addons: Flat fee additions for insulation, acoustic proofing, smart locks.
estimationLogic.subtotal: Subtotal (Actual Price Excl. Tax) = Base Cost + Material Premium + Addons
estimationLogic.totalWithTax: Total Amount (Incl. 18% Tax) = Subtotal + GST Tax Amount
estimationLogic.indicativeRange: Minimum = Total Amount | Maximum = Math.round(Total Amount * 1.15) (Rendered in Calibri font)

taxRules.displayMode: Dual amount display: Actual Subtotal before tax AND Total Amount including 18% GST tax.
